headline: Chip Stocks Turn Lower by Lunch

writeup.headline: Chip Stocks Turn Lower by Lunch
writeup.summary: This morning's big story was Hot PCE Reading Locks In a December Fed Hike. The big swing: chip stocks rallied early, then turned around after 9:59 AM and are now lower on the day — Limapagi points to “Chip Stocks Erase Two Trillion Dollar Rally”. The AI names are down and the average stock is down: stocks are moving together. Cyclical sectors are leading defensive ones, and the S&P has stayed under pressure.

themes.headline: Chip stocks gave back their early rally
themes.detail: Down 4.8% at 9:59 AM, now -6.7%; hardest hit since: Advanced Micro Devices, Nvidia. In the news: “Chip Stocks Erase Two Trillion Dollar Rally” (Limapagi).

themes.headline: S&P has stayed under pressure
themes.detail: Low at 9:44 AM, high at 10:06 AM; -0.4% since the open.

themes.headline: Materials leads, Health Care lags
themes.detail: Since the open: Materials +0.9%, Health Care -0.9%.
